loiGiai: \begin{center} \end{center} Gọi $O$ là tâm hình thoi $ABCD$, $K$ nằm trên đoạn $SH$ sao cho $HK = \displaystyle \frac{1}{4} SH = \displaystyle \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}$.\\ Ta có $SD \parallel OK \Rightarrow SD \parallel (ACK)$ và $AC \subset (ACK)$.\\ Suy ra $d(SD, AC) = d(SD, (ACK)) = d(S, (ACK)) = 3d(H, (ACK))$.\\ Kẻ $HI \perp OK$ $(I \in OK) \Rightarrow HI \perp (ACK) \Rightarrow d(H, (ACK)) = HI$.\\ Tam giác $ABC$ đều nên có $BO = \displaystyle \frac{AB\sqrt{3}}{2} = \sqrt{3}$, $HO = \displaystyle \frac{1}{3}BO = \displaystyle \frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$.\\ $HI = \displaystyle \frac{HK \cdot HO}{\sqrt{HK^2 + HO^2}} = \displaystyle \frac{\displaystyle \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \cdot \displaystyle \frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}}{\sqrt{\displaystyle \frac{3}{16} + \displaystyle \frac{3}{9}}} = \displaystyle \frac{\sqrt{3}}{5} \Rightarrow d(SD, AC) = \displaystyle \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{5} \approx 1{,}04$.
